meta.method: A deterministic sample of resolved Kalshi contracts from the existing archive, with one-minute candles in the last 72 hours before reported close. Each hourly horizon uses the latest completed positive-volume trade bar at or before the cutoff, with bar-end age at most 30 minutes. Favorites must be priced at least 51%. Missing bars are never interpolated or carried beyond that age limit. Each contract contributes once per horizon.
meta.clockNote: The anchor is the source-reported close/expiry proxy, not independently verified event occurrence. A close can follow the public result. Price changes compare completed bar closes; actual trade timestamps within a bar may differ by up to the bar length. A 30-minute bar-age limit permits an actual last trade up to 31 minutes old.
meta.intervalNote: Approximate 95% Student-t intervals cluster contracts within archive-defined parent events. Suppressed below 20 events or at zero estimated variance. They exclude source error, event-clock error, dependence between different event IDs, and multiple-comparison adjustments.
meta.moveMethod: Endpoints must both be positive-volume trade bars with completion times exactly 15, 30 or 60 minutes apart. A candidate moves by at least 5 percentage points. Prices and the result are oriented toward the outcome whose price rose; that outcome need not be the favorite. Filter by the requested move size and minimum hours before close, then retain the earliest qualifying move and require at least six hours before another move in that contract. Forward prices do not affect selection.
meta.forwardMethod: For each one-, six- or 24-hour follow-up, use the last completed positive-volume trade bar at or before the follow-up, no more than five minutes old, only when the follow-up is at or before the source anchor. Missing follow-ups stay null. Reversal rates must use only their own available follow-up denominators.
meta.volumeMethod: Window volume sums active bar quantity strictly after the start endpoint through the end endpoint. Polymarket counts only shares of the tracked outcome token, not all trading in both tokens; Kalshi counts contracts. Neither is dollar turnover. Endpoint spreads, when present, are same-minute YES ask minus bid, with both quotes strictly inside zero and one; trade and quote closes need not be simultaneous.
meta.cohortWarning: These are different, selected archives. Do not pool the two source cohorts or compare their headline scores as if they forecast the same events.

sourceManifest.sampleMethod: First N unique source-panel contracts in ascending MD5('atlas-intraday-v1|' + market_id), with market ID as tie-breaker. The source panel contains resolved binary contracts with at least one eligible trade at a daily horizon. Sampling does not inspect outcome or subsequent price moves.
sourceManifest.clock: Reported trading close. This is not verified actual event occurrence; prices in this window may have been recorded after the public outcome.
sourceManifest.priceMethod: Completed one-minute candle closes. Trade closes require positive volume. Nulls are retained; no interpolation or forward-fill. Bid and ask can be recorded in a minute without a trade. Values outside [0,1] and crossed quotes are unavailable. API 'previous' trade values are never used.
